platform.title: Built for any app with an engaged audience.
platform.sub: If your users act on what you show them, you can earn from it. Connect once through our API, and relevant offers and tracking run in the background.
items: Shopping apps
Show your users relevant products from brands they already trust, and earn a commission whenever they buy through your app.
Cashback and rewards apps
Reward your users with cashback and points on the brands they already buy, and earn a share of every qualifying purchase.
Content and community apps
Recommend products that fit your content and community, and earn a commission whenever your audience buys through your app.

how.title: How you earn.
items: Connect the API
Integrate once, and pull offers, links, and tracking straight into your app.
Surface relevant offers
Show cashback and deals your users actually want, inside your own UI.
Earn on every sale
When a user buys through your app, the sale is tracked to you.
Get paid
Withdraw in your local currency once sales are validated, or sooner with Express Withdrawal.

why.title: Why app owners build on Involve.
items: Your app, your experience.
Offers live inside your own UI. You control how they look and where they appear.
One integration, hundreds of brands.
Connect once to access 500+ brands and 4,000+ offers.
Built for developers.
Clear API docs, item-level tracking, and reliable payouts.

faq: Generate deeplinks, pull offers and product data, and track sales at item level. Deeplink generation is capped at 1,000 per rolling 30 days.
Not sure what to promote in my app?
Start with the brands your users already shop. See [Content sites](website) for ideas.
You will need a developer to connect the API. The docs cover every endpoint.
